name: Counting Out Time
objectiveText: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands . Andorhal Watch  ( 5 )

comments.body: Used on Araj the summoner, the 61 elite in Andorhal

They are found in small gray lockboxes. Mostly found in open destroyed houses. Seems to be very few around though, so very hard to find.

Check out the houses that have been burned down, they seem to be around 2 per building that has been razed to the ground.

Okay for you people that keep saying they arn't in each burned down house l have a few ideas to why you can't find them.

1.) Your bloody blind!
2.) Not looking hard enough (probably, but goes with the #1 reason.)
3.) LOOK IN CORNERS!
4.) Someone has gotten to it 1st - move on!
5.) Color blind - these lockboxes are brownish.

LOOK BLOODY HARDER! These stoopid lockboxes arn't hard to notice they're in the inside corner of each burned down house. If you haven't found one in each then that mean there are others that are doing it and got there 1st - so move on. Plus don't think its that long of a respawn for these lockboxes. Simple and plain words - LOOK BY THE CORNERS!

Good luck ^^
replies: Regarding #5. Don't look for something of a different color. These lockboxes have the same color as their surroundings. Look for the shape.
